summary: Unified right-edge contextual editing and voice recovery

changes.title: Selection tools and verified Undo/Redo
changes.detail: Use the same animated right suggestion slot as Chrome for selected text and verified keyboard-owned undo/redo. Retain existing provider/clipboard priority and no generic host fallback.

changes.title: Offline voice recovery shortcut
changes.detail: A failed transcription can offer an explicit fresh retry or a recoverable final result in the same right slot, bound to the safe current editor and existing RAM-only recovery window. Never record automatically or retain audio.
